\[\begin{array}{rcl}\displaystyle \frac{d}{d{{CT:4}}}({{CT:0}}) &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle \frac{d}{d{{CT:4}}}\left[\left(\frac{1}{{CT:2}}\right)^{{CT:3}}\right] \\ &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:3}}\left[\frac{1}{{CT:2}}\right]^{({{CT:3}}-1)}\cdot \frac{d}{d{{CT:4}}}\left[\frac{1}{{CT:2}}\right] \\ &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle \frac{{CT:3}}{{{CT:2}}^{{CT:5}}}\cdot \frac{\frac{d}{d{{CT:4}}}[1]\cdot {{CT:2}}-1\cdot \frac{d}{d{{CT:4}}}[{{CT:2}}]}{{{CT:2}}^2} \\ &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:6}}\cdot \frac{0-{{CT:7}}}{{CT:8}} \\ &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:9}} \\ &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:10}} \end{array}\]
